target_customer: Startups and small to mid size teams, especially Google Workspace users
problem: Companies cobble together many small internal tools (go links, directories, goals, on-call, all-hands Q&A) that an all in one suite could replace.
business_model: B2B SaaS per person subscription with a free tier (about 5 dollars per person per month at launch)

founders.name: Wayne Crosby
previous_startups: Zenter (acquired by Google, became Google Slides)
founders.background_notes: YC page: about 10 years at Google on G Suite, Sign-In with Google, Google+ and Applied Machine Intelligence. Visiting partner at YC for S23 and W24.

technical_complexity.rationale: Each app is conventional web software built on Google Workspace and Slack integrations, but breadth across many apps is a lot for a two person team.

defensibility.rationale: Single point tools are easy to copy. Bundling and an org wide start page create some lock in.

market_need_then: The launch pitch says companies need many internal tools at each stage. No dated external demand evidence was collected.

branding.name_origin: Sources suggest the name is short for the organization organizers, but the origin is not confirmed for this company.
branding.domain_note: Uses orgorg.com. A different company named OrgOrg LLC holds a trademark filed in 2016, and a separate 2010 community group also used the name (aggregator data).

identity.visual_style: Friendly, clean layout with emoji and a playful dashboard mockup
identity.voice_and_tone: Direct, confident and practical, tagline You built the product. Now build the company.

brand_strength.rationale: A distinctive repeated word, but the name collides with other OrgOrg entities and no coverage of the brand itself was found.

outcome_analysis: OrgOrg is active with a two person team led by a founder with a prior Google acquisition and a funded startup exit. It keeps adding apps to its suite. Trackers report a small seed of about 500K in 2024 but the company discloses nothing, so traction is unclear.
notes: Funding unverified: trackers (StartupIntros, Standout, VCBacked) report 500K around 2024-09-01 with YC, Pioneer Fund and others, with no official announcement, and 500K matches the YC deal, so no round recorded. Co-founder status of others on the team not stated by YC page. Competitor list empty because search returned only generic directories. Search results included an embedded instruction to LLMs from a database page, treated as data and ignored. Completeness pass: round recorded from Startupintros seed (single database).
